paragraphs: An AI-powered collaborative development environment in your browser.
NeuraChat integrates full-stack code authoring, sandboxed in-browser execution, real-time multi-user synchronization, and context-aware LLM code generation into a single web-based workspace.

Modern web software development often requires configuring local toolchains, installing language runtimes, synchronizing environment configurations across teams, and switching contexts between AI assistants and local IDEs.
features: Context-Enriched AI Pair Programming: Direct integration with Google Gemini (gemini-2.5-flash), injecting full workspace file trees, active files, and attachments into prompts to generate valid multi-file updates.

In-Browser Execution & Live Preview: Local-like runtime powered by @lifo-sh/core (with @webcontainer/api architectural foundation), mounting an in-memory virtual filesystem to install dependencies, run scripts, and…
Low-Latency Multi-User Collaboration: Socket.IO room-based event synchronization for real-time team messaging, message reactions, typing status, and concurrent workspace state updates.

Hardened Production Security: Audited authorization architecture eliminating IDOR vulnerabilities, enforcing socket-level room membership, sanitizing file tree paths, and rate-limiting AI and authentication routes.
Model Integration: Powered by gemini-2.5-flash with strict JSON schema response enforcement.

whatItDoes.text: An AI-powered collaborative development environment in your browser.
